moments.action: A greying man in a NAVY hoodie sits alone with a beer in the dim room; the young man eases his head around the doorframe to check the coast, and the older man is already talking - he has been waiting up.
The young man comes all the way in and stops at the cluttered table; the older man stays seated and talks him down, and by the last shot the kid is standing off across the room, answering back.
The older man is on his feet now, face to face with the kid in the dark; they trade looks in tight singles until the young man breaks the stare and turns away past the lamp.
A hand snatches a car key off the paper-piled desk; the older man comes after it in a blur of movement, and the young man, stopped in the blue-lit back room, turns to find him right there.
Pressed close in the blue-lit room, the older man leans into the young man's face and keeps on at him; the singles tighten into a held two-shot of profiles with neither of them giving ground.
The young man takes the last of it without answering, then backs off; the older man is left watching the doorway with the kid a dim shape in it, and the scene settles on his face alone.
Cut to daylight and a dense crowd of Tokyo commuters in dark coats pushing toward the camera; one young man in the middle holds still and in focus while the rest stream past him.
In a school corridor the foreign kid in a black uniform walks past a 2006 college poster as Japanese students cut across him; he keeps his head down until he lifts it straight into the lens.
He clocks classmates coming the other way - a kid in a white du-rag, a girl in uniform, another student - and watches them pass; a grinning student goes by and he ends up staring off, unsmiling.
He trails another student out past the bike racks into the street, where uniformed kids crowd the pavement around a parked orange sports car with a man sitting back on its hood.
